item.title: MBA 2026 forecast: Slow growth amid inflation, rate hikes
item.description: MBA’s December forecast projects economic growth of 1.6% in 2025 and puts the chance of a recession over the next 12 months at 35%.

item.title: Mortgage rates cool in 2025, but 2026 relief likely limited
item.description: Mortgage rates started the year slightly above 7% but are heading into the holiday season near 6.2%. 2026 forecasts show little change ahead.

item.title: Texas proposes property tax cuts for homeowners 55+
item.description: Texas Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick's "Operation Double Nickel" proposes lowering the senior property tax benefit age to 55 and expanding exemptions.

item.title: Mortgage applications fall 5% despite rate decline
item.description: Despite steady mortgage rates, market trends like a softening job market and elevated inventories continue to impact application volumes.

item.title: Why the DSCR loan became the investor darling of 2025
item.description: DSCR loans are gaining popularity among real estate investors as lenders refine underwriting processes and secondary market confidence grows.

item.title: NAR legislative priorities for 2026 focus on housing supply, affordability
item.description: NAR’s 2026 priorities focus on bipartisan solutions to expand housing inventory and address affordability challenges.

item.title: DOJ wants antitrust review of real estate commissions in Davis suit
item.description: The DOJ filed a statement in the Davis lawsuit, arguing real estate agent commissions remain inflated due to trade group rules.

item.title: Compass-Anywhere deal may exceed DOJ market-share limits in some cities
item.description: The Compass-Anywhere merger may give one firm over 30% market share in key cities, raising antitrust concerns.

item.title: The U.S. housing market in 2025: A year of normalization
item.description: U.S. housing inventory rose 16.4% in 2025, flattening prices and extending days on market as balance returned.

item.title: Compass, NWMLS clash over document production in antitrust suit
item.description: Compass accuses NWMLS of delaying document production in their antitrust lawsuit, with trial now set for October 2026.
